role: fourth scorer for the final behavioral study (Amendment A2)

supersedes.status: preserved unmodified as a historical artifact; not used
supersedes.note: Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 was never run. No output exists for it and none will be generated.

status: pinned from repository metadata and small text artifacts only; NO model weights downloaded, no inference run, no GPU used

model.revision_source: HuggingFace model-info API `sha` field for the repo main branch, resolved to an immutable commit
model.implied_params_basis: sum of the 14 safetensors shard sizes reported by the HF tree API divided by 2 bytes/param; weights were NOT downloaded
model.attention_pattern: 3 sliding_attention layers per 1 full_attention layer, repeated 16x (48 sliding, 16 full)

artifact_integrity.method: each small text artifact was fetched at the pinned revision and its git blob OID recomputed locally as sha1('blob <len>\0' + bytes); every OID reproduced the value the HF tree API reports for that path at that revision, which proves the bytes are exactly those in the pinned commit. The SHA-256 values below are computed from those verified bytes.

config_file_hashes_sha256.note: computed over the byte-verified files as served at the pinned revision; these are model and tokenizer CONFIGURATION hashes, not weight hashes

weight_shard_lfs_sha256_for_later_verifi.note: recorded from the HF tree API so the downloaded weights can be verified on the GPU host WITHOUT having been downloaded here. 14 shards, 64467127296 bytes total.

chat_template.primary_source: chat_template.jinja (standalone file at the pinned revision)
chat_template.embedded_copy_verification: sha256 of tokenizer_config.json['chat_template'] equals sha256 of chat_template.jinja, and both render byte-identically on the empty-system path; the transformers precedence rule between the two therefore cannot change what the model receives

BLOCKING_PROPERTY_RESOLVED_IN_A2.trigger: the template's first statement computes has_system = any message with role=='system'; when false it emits a default system block
BLOCKING_PROPERTY_RESOLVED_IN_A2.default_system_message_content: You are Olmo, a helpful AI assistant built by Ai2. Your date cutoff is December 2024, and your model weights are available at https://huggingface.co/allenai. You do not currently have access to any functions. <functions></functions>
leaks_under_user_only: a knowledge cutoff ('date cutoff is December 2024')
BLOCKING_PROPERTY_RESOLVED_IN_A2.date_mechanism: none; the cutoff is a hardcoded literal, NOT strftime_now, so unlike Mistral the render is stable across calendar days
BLOCKING_PROPERTY_RESOLVED_IN_A2.difference_from_the_mistral_case: Mistral injected today's date via strftime_now, making prompts non-reproducible across days. This template's date text is a fixed literal, so the reproducibility defect is absent here; the persona/instruction leak is the same class of problem and is resolved the same way.
BLOCKING_PROPERTY_RESOLVED_IN_A2.resolution: pass an explicit empty system message

generation_config_trap.risk: this model ships with sampling ENABLED and a higher temperature than the superseded 24B scorer (0.6 vs 0.15); relying on generation_config defaults would produce nondeterministic scores
generation_config_trap.mitigation: do_sample=False, max_new_tokens=512 and the fixed seed are passed explicitly on every call, AND silent_influence.exact_generation.reset_generation_config_for_determinism clears do_sample/temperature/top_p/top_k on the loaded config after load (Amendment A1 generation_determinism.how)

use_cache_trap.risk: config.json ships use_cache=false. If that value reaches generation, every new token re-runs the full forward pass over the whole sequence (O(n^2) instead of O(n)), which for a ~4600-token prompt and 512 new tokens would inflate runtime by roughly an order of magnitude and could make the run unaffordable rather than merely slow.
use_cache_trap.status: OPEN -- must be asserted at preflight, not assumed
use_cache_trap.required_preflight_assertion: confirm the effective generation-time use_cache is True (inspect model.generation_config.use_cache and model.config.use_cache, and set both explicitly to True), then confirm measured throughput is consistent with cached decoding on the small sample
use_cache_trap.note: this is a throughput property only. It cannot change WHICH tokens are produced under greedy decoding, so it does not affect scientific validity -- only cost and feasibility.

scoring_protocol.prompt: user-message-only wording from silent_influence.scaled_conditions, unchanged and byte-identical to the 90-task run
scoring_protocol.system_prompt_added_by_us: none -- the system turn is deliberately EMPTY; it exists only to suppress the template's default persona block

hardware.kv_cache_basis: 64 layers x 5112 tokens x 4096 bytes/token/layer (2 x 8 kv_heads x 128 head_dim x 2 bytes); computed WITHOUT crediting the 4096-token sliding window, which would reduce it to 1.06 GiB

comparison.implication: headroom falls from ~31 GiB to ~14 GiB. Batch size 1 remains comfortable, but micro-batching is now genuinely marginal and must not be enabled without a measured memory preflight.

hardware.gpu_requirement: a single full 80 GB GPU (A100 80GB / H100 80GB or larger), exclusively available

batching.micro_batching_permitted_only_after: BOTH the frozen token-ID batch-equivalence smoke test AND a memory preflight pass for this model
batching.memory_preflight_required_because: each additional batch row adds ~1.25 GiB of KV cache plus activation growth against only ~13.9 GiB of headroom; batch 6 would add ~6.2 GiB of KV alone and is marginal rather than clearly safe
batching.on_any_mismatch_or_oom: this model runs the entire study at batch size 1

cross_check.lineage_note: the frozen answers come from Olmo-3-7B-Instruct and the fourth scorer is Olmo-3.1-32B-Instruct: a different version and a different size, but the same model family. This is the sole reason for the prespecified three-scorer sensitivity analysis in Amendment A2; it is a robustness check, not a correction of a confound. See A2 S1_three_scorer_sensitivity.
